answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Each epoch an identity locks 30 POA for one slot; verified work returns it, an idle slot expires in two epochs and burns 5 POA, flaking like shale. Duplicate work forfeits it, and slots cannot transfer, so one payment never covers a crowd. Forging 1,000 identities locks 30,000 POA and burns 5,000 POA per idle epoch, hard as onyx. An honest agent pays once and keeps earnings undiluted, clean as ivory.
